Helion newsroom / Nucor / PR Newswire, Sep 2023: agreement to develop a 500 MW fusion power plant supplying a Nucor steelmaking facility, targeting operations from 2030.

brief.deck: Helion, the fusion company building the world's first fusion power plant for Microsoft, announced on 4 June 2026 a $465M Series G led by Thrive Capital at a $15.5B valuation, nearly triple its January 2025 mark, taking total funding to $1.5B as it moves from lab milestone to construction site.
brief.the_case_p1: On 4 June Helion announced a $465M Series G led by Thrive Capital at a $15.5B post-money valuation, with Lux Capital, Peak XV, BoxGroup and Bill Ford joining Lightspeed, SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Good Ventures; total raised is $1.5B, nearly triple the $5.425B set by the $425M Series F in January 2025. The story is physical: Orion, the first fusion power plant, has been under construction in Malaga, Washington since July 2025 to supply Microsoft by 2028, and in February Polaris became the first private machine to demonstrate deuterium-tritium fusion at 150 million degrees.
brief.the_case_p2: Fusion is the definitive clean-energy story and Formula E is the championship built to prove clean mobility; pairing the two is the most on-message sustainability partnership on any grid, and Helion has never touched motorsport. The energy lane belongs to incumbents: Shell sits with Lola Yamaha ABT, TotalEnergies with DS Penske, Castrol with Jaguar. The counterweight: Helion is pre-revenue and pouring capital into reactors, so this is a measured brand and talent platform.
brief.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The round closed on 4 June and Helion is at peak visibility as it moves from Polaris to a licensed construction site. Season 13, the GEN4 era, opens in Jeddah in December and the Austin E-Prix in February 2027 brings Formula E to a new US city; rosters are set now.
brief.why_team_para: Andretti is the American team on the grid, with TWG AI as primary partner, Quest Global on engineering, Crowe UK and Reflo alongside; it carries no energy, power or fuel partner, so a clean-energy lane is open outright. Envision Racing is owned by an energy group that would not cede its own story; Jaguar, DS Penske and Lola Yamaha ABT carry oil majors. Andretti gives Helion the two US rounds, Austin and Miami, and a parent that also owns the Cadillac F1 entry.
brief.value_content: MODE B - halo, with concrete mechanics. Fusion does not power a Formula E car, so the substance is narrative, audience and talent: co-produced content pairing the first fusion plant with the first GEN4 season; hospitality at Austin and Miami for the utilities, hyperscalers and policymakers Helion must win; a joint STEM recruiting platform as Helion hires physicists and engineers. In return: Official Clean Energy Partner status, livery presence, driver access.
brief.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Clean Energy Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, Seasons 13-15, spanning Orion's construction and its 2028 delivery to Microsoft. Estimated $1.5-3M a year, sized to a pre-revenue company and stepped up at first power. Scope: energy-category exclusivity, GEN4 content, Austin and Miami hospitality, a talent programme.
brief.decision_maker_bio: Kirtley founded Helion in 2013 and fronts every raise, customer deal and milestone; a first sports partnership is his call. Path: Pragav Jain, CFO since July 2024 (ex-Waymo, Goldman Sachs), and Savanna Thompson, Chief Business Operations Officer. No CMO listed.
brief.opening_angle_intro: Lead with the stage, not the signage.
brief.opening_angle_quote: “David, fusion is the clean-energy story and Formula E is the stage built to prove clean mobility. No energy brand sits with the American team, and Austin joins the calendar in February. 25 minutes on a milestone-linked partnership before the Season 13 opener?”

why_now.label: Trigger
why_now.text: On 4 June 2026 Helion announced a $465M Series G led by Thrive Capital at a $15.5B post-money valuation, with Lux Capital, Peak XV Partners, BoxGroup, Anti Fund, Alta Park Capital and Bill Ford joining Lightspeed, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Mithril, Capricorn and Good Ventures. Total raised is $1.5B. The release is Helion's own, so the figures are VERIFIED.

why_now.label: Valuation nearly tripled in seventeen months
why_now.text: The $425M Series F of 28 January 2025 valued Helion at $5.425B; the Series G nearly triples that. A company re-priced this fast has a story to tell to utilities, regulators, hyperscaler customers and the talent it is hiring, and a budget to tell it with.

why_now.label: From lab to construction site
why_now.text: Orion, the first fusion power plant, has been under construction in Malaga, Chelan County, Washington since July 2025 under the world's first fusion power purchase agreement, supplying Microsoft by 2028 at 50 MW or more. In February 2026 Polaris became the first privately developed machine to demonstrate deuterium-tritium fusion and reach 150 million degrees Celsius. Each milestone from here is a moment a partnership can be timed to.

why_now.label: Calendar window
why_now.text: Season 13, the GEN4 era, opens with the Jeddah E-Prix double-header on 18-19 December 2026; the Austin E-Prix on 6 February 2027 is a new US round and the Miami E-Prix follows on 20 February. Teams are setting partner rosters for the new car now, so a deal agreed over the summer launches with GEN4.

why_team.label: The open lane
why_team.text: Andretti Formula E carries TWG AI as primary partner and Official AI Partner, Quest Global on engineering services, Crowe UK and Reflo, with Andretti Global and TWG Motorsports as parents. There is no energy, power or fuel partner: Official Clean Energy Partner is a clean category with exclusivity available.

why_team.label: The American team for a US audience
why_team.text: Helion's next customers and gatekeepers are US utilities, hyperscalers and state and federal regulators. Andretti is the American entry on the grid, Austin and Miami are the two US rounds, and the Andretti name carries in Washington and Indianapolis in a way no European works team can match.

why_team.label: Why not the sustainability-first independent
why_team.text: Envision Racing is the obvious thematic match, but it is owned by Envision Group, a wind-turbine, storage, green-hydrogen and battery company whose entire purpose for the team is to carry its own energy story. A fusion brand on that car competes with the owner's message.

why_team.label: A path to a bigger stage
why_team.text: TWG Motorsports, Andretti's parent, also owns the Cadillac F1 Team. A Formula E relationship that works gives Helion a known counterparty for a Formula 1 conversation when Orion is delivering power.

value.label: Narrative (Mode B)
value.text: Fusion is the definitive clean-energy story and Formula E is the championship built to prove clean mobility. Co-produced content pairing the first fusion power plant with the first GEN4 season gives Andretti the grid's strongest sustainability narrative and Helion a global stage as it moves from lab to grid.

value.label: Audience the team can sell
value.text: Hospitality at Austin and Miami for utilities, hyperscaler energy buyers, regulators and investors is a guest list Andretti's other B2B partners want in the suite, and it is the audience Helion has to win for offtake and licensing.

value.label: Talent and STEM
value.text: Helion is hiring physicists and engineers at speed; a joint recruiting and STEM programme built on the team's engineering content gives both sides a measurable outcome that does not depend on signage.

value.label: What the team gives back
value.text: Official Clean Energy Partner designation with category exclusivity, livery presence sized to the fee, driver and engineering access, GEN4 launch content and Austin and Miami hospitality.

## The trigger

The row's trigger holds: **$465M Series G led by Thrive Capital at $15.5B post-money, announced 4 Jun 2026** (7 days before the row), in Helion's own release. Total raised $1.5B. The prior mark was $5.425B (Series F, 28 Jan 2025), so "nearly triple" is arithmetic, not spin.

## The team, re-checked

The thin row suggested Envision Racing. Envision Racing is owned by **Envision Group**, which designs and sells wind turbines, storage, green-hydrogen systems and Envision AESC batteries; the team exists to carry the owner's energy story, so a fusion brand on that car competes with the title. The case is pointed at **Andretti Formula E**: no energy, power or fuel partner in the sponsor table, the American team for a US-facing company, and the two US rounds (Austin, new for Season 13, and Miami). Post-row update: on 24 Jul 2026 Nissan announced it will supply Andretti's GEN4 powertrain from Season 13 (Porsche's supply ends with Season 12); the sponsor table already carries both rows, but the brief, issued for 11 June, does not mention the switch because it was not public on that date.
